title: Six Months Before Anyone Would Borrow: Kashf's First Loans in Lahore
conflicts: Founding year: PBS says 1995; Zafar (Wharton) says preparatory work in 1995, registration June 1996, first loans November 1996; used the 1996 dates. Time at Grameen: ten weeks (Wharton) vs three months (Incofin); used ten weeks. Yunus's $10,000: a loan (Wharton) vs a cheque never reclaimed (Incofin); story says only that he offered it. Client numbers differ by year (301,000 in 2009, ~300,000 in 2011, 340,000 in 2017, 535,000 in 2019) and Wharton's summary also gives a cumulative 1 million; story uses dated figures only.
notes: Quote stance 'affirms'. The 35 per cent effective interest rate (PBS, 2011) is stated plainly, without comment. Zafar's SSIR first-person essay is a PDF whose text could not be extracted, so it is not cited.
